card.name: Herpes virus lists and punctuation
card.fires_on: Small linking words, commas, spaces or brackets right after herpes simplex, varicella zoster or herpesvirus, where another virus or a number is expected next.

modes.label: Joiner after herpes name
modes.description: A comma, 'and' or bracket follows a herpes virus name in a list of viruses.
modes.example: herpes simplex<< and>> varicella zoster viruses

modes.label: Space before virus number
modes.description: A space after 'herpes simplex viruses' just before the type numbers 1 and 2.

modes.label: Herpes treatment text
modes.description: Words inside herpes treatment or dosing passages, such as 'by' after 'caused' or 'over' before an infusion time.
modes.example: (infused at a constant rate over<< >>1 hour every 8 hours)
